automation.text:
**Thunderous Cry.** You can use a Bonus Action to release a frightening battle cry. Roll a Charisma (Intimidation) check. One creature of your choice that can hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to your Charisma (Intimidation) check result or have the Frightened condition for 1d4 rounds. The target can make a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Once you've used this ability, you can't use it again until you've completed a Short Rest.

At higher levels, you can target an additional number of creatures with this ability. At 9th level, you can target two creatures. At 15th level, you can target three creatures, and the range of this ability increases to 60 feet.

**Prophetic Vision.** As a Magic action, you can choose one Divination spell with a casting time of 1 action (from any spell list) of a level you can cast that is no more than half your character level and cast it without expending a spell slot. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability stat. Once you use this feat to cast the spell, you can't use it again until you complete a Long Rest.

**Awareness of the Guardian.** When you make a Wisdom (Perception) check, you can decide to give yourself Advantage. You can do this a number of times per day equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Vigilance.** When you roll Initiative, you can reroll the check but must use the new result. Once you use this feature, you must finish a Long Rest before you can use it again.

**Call Sea Serpent.** You can cast Find Steed without expending a spell slot. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

**Hunter's Eye.** When you use the Attack action to make a ranged weapon attack, you can choose to give yourself Advantage on the attack roll. Once you use this feature you must finish a Short or Long Rest before you can use it again.

**Frozen Edge.** You know the Ice Knife Spell. You can cast it without using a spell slot a number of times per day equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

**Shield of the North Wind.** If you fail a saving throw against a spell or effect that deals Cold damage, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this feature you must finish a Long Rest before you can use it again.

name: Blessing of Tyr
description: You can use this feature at will, but when you use it on a creature, you must finish a Long Rest before you can use it on that creature again.

automation.text:
**Justicar.** As a Magic action, you can touch a creature and compel it to tell the truth. The creature must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't speak a deliberate lie for 1 minute. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save. An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

You can use this feature at will, but when you use it on a creature, you must finish a Long Rest before you can use it on that creature again.

**Berserker Fury.** When you are Bloodied, you can use a Bonus Action to enter a frenzied state. While in this fury, your melee weapon attacks deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you don't have the Unconscious condition when you are reduced to 0 HP (though you still make Death Saves as normal).

Your Berserker Fury lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required), or if you have the Incapacitated condition. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Add `-d {proficiencyBonus}` to your melee weapon attacks.

onTrue.text: **Bloodied Reaction.** While you're Bloodied and take any damage, you can spend one of your Hit Dice as a Reaction and reduce the damage you take by the amount rolled. You can only spend one Hit Die at a time in this way, each time you are damaged.

automation.text: **Inner Fire.** Pain bolsters your resolve. When you take damage, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws until the end of your next turn. While you are Bloodied, the bonus to saves increases to +2, and you also gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

**Mighty Yell.** When you score a Critical Hit against a target, you let out a boisterous roar. You and allies within 5 feet of you have Resistance to all damage until the end of your next turn, and enemies within 5 feet of you have Vulnerability to all damage until the end of your next turn.

Use `-choice [resist|vuln]` to determine the effect.

**Staunch Will.** You have Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition. Also, you can use a Bonus Action to end the Frightened condition on yourself a number of times per day equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

**Heroic Windfall.** Whenever you use Heroic Inspiration, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to the die roll. If you are already at your Hit Point maximum when you use Heroic Inspiration, you instead gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the die roll. If you use Heroic Inspiration, and you roll higher on the die than is necessary to restore you to your Hit Point maximum, you gain any excess as Temporary Hit Points.

- The creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 minute as a terrible cold numbs its body.
- The creature is coated in ice. It has the Restrained condition until it succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw to free itself (equal to your spell saving throw DC) or takes at least 10 points of Bludgeoning or Fire damage. It can make the save to end this effect at the end of each of its turns.
- The creature has Vulnerability to Cold damage for 1 minute. It can make a Constitution saving throw (equal to your spell saving throw DC) to end this effect at the end of each of its turns.

Use `-choice <dis|res|vul>` to choose an effect.

You can use Fimbulwinter's Grasp a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
